_meta.note: Verbatim example message payload (the 'msg' object) from the doc's own AsyncAPI 'example' block. Deliberately has NO fill_id field - the WS fill message's real identity field is trade_id ('Unique identifier for fills. This is what you use to differentiate fills'); fill_id only exists on the REST GetFills Fill schema (docs/kalshi/get-fills.md), which documents trade_id as 'same as fill_id' there. A handler keyed on fill_id alone silently discards every real WS fill - this fixture is what proves it. exchange_index (2026-08-30, issue #251, Trade API 3.29.0) is now a required field of this message (user-fills.md:207) - the value below is the doc's own example (user-fills.md:326: "exchange_index": 2).
